title: Wingtips, White Paint, and a Very Confident Scott Kirby
summary: A UPS freighter and a Copa jet trade paint on a Miami taxiway, and somehow nobody got hurt. Plus, the fallout from Friday's ground stop keeps getting weirder, Emirates and Qantas take completely opposite bets on the A380, and United's CEO says a merger with American is a lock — which is a wild thing to say out loud.
